tasks.description: Implement the targeted account Storage batch component and fresh verification against the accepted private plan.
constraints: Local production component plus isolated Deno mocks. Return exact Git diff in JSON; controller applies. No endpoint, worker scheduling, SQL grants, staging, real removals, profile/Auth/purchase changes or unrelated refactor. The private RPC is still ungranted, so no external execution path is added.

Implement a single-account one-batch helper consistent with runPlantStoragePurge. Validate the canonical lowercase owner UUID and exact RPC plan shape, same owner_id, at most 20 ordered unique lowercase photo UUIDs, nonnegative safe integer hold counts, and consistent storage_ready. Derive only ownerUUID/photoUUID under the existing private DIAGNOSIS_PHOTO_BUCKET; accept no storage paths from callers/SQL. Use one bounded idempotent remove call for a nonempty verified batch, then a fresh from-start read of the accepted work plan. Never report ready without that evidence, never change DB/account state, preserve pending if objects/holds survive. Surface retryable I/O failure without logging raw objects, credentials or owner data. Absent plan before work is no work; disappearing/malformed plan after remove is error rather than readiness.

Deno fixture cases: no plan, already ready, >1 page continuation, exact scoped bucket/key map, owner mismatch or invalid shape rejected before remove, remove failure, stale surviving object/holds, and fresh ready only after successful independent read. Reuse existing app types and mocked HttpClient style. T082/T083 remain open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Scoped diff with typechecked internal component.
Deno mock Storage and canonical plan tests verify targeted and idempotent only.
